department: David A. Dunlap Department of Astronomy & Astrophysics

deadline.value: Apply by Friday, December 11 (one round a year, September entry). The page prints 2025 but the weekdays match the 2027-entry cycle (opens Monday, October 12).
deadline.quote: We have only one admissions round annually for September entry. | Application open: Monday, October 12, 2025 | Application deadline: Friday, December 11, 2025

gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not accepted.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores, including Physics Subject, are not accepted.
gre_subject.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is not accepted.

supervisor.value: No supervisor needed to apply; direct-entry PhD students choose one during the first year.
supervisor.quote: You do not need to find a faculty supervisor during the application stage. We do not admit students at the onset to work with a particular faculty member.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students are funded: 5 years for direct-entry, at least CAD 40,000 a year after tuition and fees.
funding.quote: All successful doctoral stream program applicants are guaranteed financial support: 5 years of funding for the PhD direct-entry and 4 years of funding for those with a qualifying MSc degree. | The intent of the departmental graduate student funding level is to ensure that all students have at least $40,000 (inclusive of top-ups) after payment of tuition, non-academic fees and UTGSU fees.

entry_route.value: For 2027 entry only the 5-year direct-entry PhD (from a bachelor's) is open; the 4-year track for master's holders is paused. There is no separate master's program.
entry_route.quote: Please note that we have paused admissions for the PhD 4-year track for the 2027 cycle. We are accepting applications for the direct entry PhD program.

also.quote: the default entry point for an applicant with a qualifying bachelor’s degree is the PhD direct-entry program

notes: Three reference letters; A- average in final two years required for direct entry. Fee CAD 135.
